name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, forced LongFast public default behavior, on-device WiFi scan/select, GPS/compass refresh fixes, map page switching, offline/SD map prep, compact map/cache status, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, latest-activity chat ordering, node-name fallback cleanup, SD message journal support, SD settings backup/restore support, SD prepare/reset tools, SD setup detection/progress readouts, SD-card notice controls, SD ringtone folder support, screen correction tools, serial recovery, a boot progress bar, the Modern Field on-device theme/layout, a public on-device health panel, app-only Wi-Fi updates, home LoRa RX overlap fixes, and a persistent sidebar-left/right system setting defaulted to the right side.

release.label: Z-Deck 0.2.23-cyberdeck
release.channelDefaults: LongFast public setup; users add private/admin channels after flashing

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, settings backups, ringtone storage, logs, and prepare/reset setup; USB mass storage is disabled in this public build to keep serial stable.

build.status: WSL PlatformIO build completed successfully from the public patch stack. This public-safe zdeck24 build adds the sidebar placement system setting with right-side default and persistent /zdeck_sidebar.cfg storage, and keeps Wi-Fi scan/select, app-only OTA, SD settings backup/restore, SD chat history, map switching, newest-first chats, stable names, send status, hop counters, and prior home/map fixes.

publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
